items.title: Fix silent anchor failure in verify_chain
items.why_now: Corrupt anchor silently disables truncation detection, which is a data integrity risk. This is a confirmed medium-severity bug that can cause undetected data loss.

steps.do: In daedalus/spine/anchor.py, modify read_anchor to raise an exception (e.g., ValueError) on JSONDecodeError instead of returning None, or log a critical error and raise.
steps.verified_by: Create a corrupt anchor file (truncate) and run verify_chain; verify that an exception is raised and logged.

steps.do: In daedalus/spine/chain.py, update verify_chain to handle the new exception from read_anchor appropriately (e.g., abort chain verification).
steps.verified_by: Run chain verification with corrupt anchor; observe that verification fails with error.

items.assumption: The file paths daedalus/spine/anchor.py and daedalus/spine/chain.py exist and contain the functions read_anchor and verify_chain as described in the finding.

items.title: Fix exception leak in promote_candidates
items.why_now: promote_candidates claims 'Never raises' but can raise unhandled exceptions (e.g., OSError), violating contract and potentially crashing the system. High severity.

steps.do: In daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py, wrap the body of promote_candidates in a try-except that catches Exception, logs the error, and raises PromotionUnavailable (or handles gracefully).
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'except\|raise' daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py | head -20 shows new except clause. Unit test: call promote_candidates with a mock that raises OSError; verify PromotionUnavailable is raised.

items.assumption: The file daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py exists and contains promote_candidates as described.
